Name: Fast Eat
Author: Zexu2K
Description:
[size=3][b][left]Most [u]impor[/u][b][u]tant thing[/u] you need to know:[/b][/left][/b][/size][size=6]Just press [/size][color=#ffff00][size=6]V[/size][/color][size=6] on keybord in the game to eat fast!![/size]
[size=3][i]
[/i][/size][size=3][center][b]﻿[/b][size=3]New first way (first edible item in hotbar):[/size][/center][/size][center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/05f1Mk4d/new-eat.gif[/img][/center][center]﻿[size=3]New second way (selected item):[/size]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/Wz2h8vxZ/ezgif-com-video-to-gif-converter.gif[/img][/center][center][i][size=4]Old way:[/size][/i]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/02yRpgRg/old-eat.gif[/img][/center]

[b][size=5]More info [/size][size=3](helpful info)[/size][size=5]:[/size][/b]
The mod enables quicker eating; there's no need for quick click to eat something when you're in the mine anymore—just press a single button!
[b][size=3]Press the V key on your keyboard[/size][/b], and your character will consume the first item in the hotbar (progressing from left to right) or just selected iteam.[size=3][b]
[/b]
[b]Eat Second Item Key[/b] is similar to [b]Fast Eat key[/b] but difference is character eats [b]second meal[/b] in order form left to right.

[b]If you wish, You can adjust this button, behaviors and second button in the config.json file or through the [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][b].[/b]
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/j5YWWNXZ/menu.png[/img]﻿[/center][u][s][center][/center][/s][/u][/size][img]https://i.postimg.cc/GtBs4yjB/11-06-2024-23-18online-video-cutter-com-ezgif-com-crop.gif[/img]
Note:
This mod is designed to enhance your gameplay, making things smoother. Should you come across any glitches or issues, kindly notify me through the mod's dedicated website for prompt resolution. 🤠🍔🍕
